elements.name: User Dashboard Boundary Component
elements.role: UserDashboardGUI handles user dashboard display and role-specific feature configuration for citizens and municipal operators.

elements.name: User Login Boundary Component
elements.role: UserLoginGUI handles user sign-in input collection and credential submission.

elements.name: User Registration Boundary Component
elements.role: UserRegistrationGUI handles user registration input collection and delegation to system services.

elements.name: Report Review Controller Component
elements.role: ReportReviewController handles retrieving submitted and received reports based on user roles.

elements.name: User Login Controller Component
elements.role: UserLoginController handles verifying user login credentials and session data.

elements.name: User Registration Controller Component
elements.role: UserRegistrationController handles validation and processing of user registration requests.

elements.name: Database Connection Utility Component
elements.role: JpaUtil manages JPA entity manager factory instances for persistence operations.

elements.name: Persistence Service Component
elements.role: PersistenceService executes generic database operations such as save, update, and find using EntityManagers.

elements.name: Boundary
elements.role: The Boundary package contains user interface classes such as UserDashboardGUI, UserLoginGUI, and UserRegistrationGUI.

elements.name: Control
elements.role: The Control package contains controllers such as ReportReviewController, UserLoginController, and UserRegistrationController.

elements.name: Database
elements.role: The Database package contains persistence utility and service classes like JpaUtil and PersistenceService.

elements.name: UserLoginGUI
elements.role: UserLoginGUI uses UserLoginController from the Control layer.

elements.name: PersistenceService
elements.role: PersistenceService uses JpaUtil within the Database layer.

elements.name: User Boundary Module
elements.role: User-facing functionality is organized in GUI boundary components such as UserLoginGUI, UserRegistrationGUI, and UserDashboardGUI.

elements.name: Control Logic Module
elements.role: Application control logic is structured into controller classes like UserLoginController, UserRegistrationController, and ReportReviewController.

elements.name: Persistence Module
elements.role: Data persistence and database operations are managed through JpaUtil and PersistenceService.
